package.description: Make devices and applications wireless with Serial to Ethernet Connector

en-US.description: Make devices and applications wireless with Serial to Ethernet Connector
en-US.longDescription:
Serial to Ethernet Connector is an application that allows you to share COM
devices connected to a computer to other computers on the same local network. It
can also create virtual ports in order to exchange data with applications that
use a serial interface. Serial to Ethernet Connector can be set up for a variety
of uses, including access to serial devices from inside a virtual machine.
en-US.name: Serial to Ethernet Connector
